messages.subject: For Joe Bae and Scott Nuttall | Infrastructure, strategic partnerships and emerging-market execution
messages.body:
Dear KKR Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Co-Chief Executive Officers Joe Bae and Scott Nuttall.

KKR's growing infrastructure and strategic-investment platform operates across markets where government relationships, regulation and operating execution directly influence long-term value. That environment aligns closely with my experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex cross-functional stakeholder matters.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, strategic partnerships and emerging-market execution might support KKR's portfolio or international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to KKR.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
